title: European Innovation Council launches €1.8 billion in funding for 2027

The funding will help turn breakthrough research into market-ready innovations and strengthen Europe's ability to scale strategic technologies.

title: New plan to boost sustainable tourism in Europe
content: Europe is the world's leading travel destination and tourism is one of its greatest strategic economic assets. title: Commission and European Space Agency launch new website on climate change research

title: EU future enlargement: Countries' progress on the EU path
content: Enlargement is a merit-based process where enlargement countries must align with EU values and legislation to become an EU Member State. The European Commission has assessed the progress made over the past year by countries looking to join the EU and set out reform priorities for the way forward.

title: Commission gives guidelines on how Europeans can prepare for a crisis
content: As Europe faces increasingly frequent crises, the European Commission has presented new guidelines to help people and communities prepare for emergencies. The guidelines include advice on what essentials to pack for a 72-hour emergency and making sure persons with disabilities are not excluded.

title: EU-funded research advancing our understanding of liver cancer

title: Newborn immunisation against respiratory virus could cut infant winter hospitalisations

title: Investigation into migration deal between Italy and Albania wins 2026 Daphne Caruana Galizia Prize for Journalism

title: Winners of 2026 Megalizzi–Niedzielski prize for aspiring journalists announced
content: Yoana Kaloyanova (Bulgaria), Žan Tone Urbanija (Slovenia), and Marie Hartmann (Germany) have won the 2026 Megalizzi–Niedzielski prize for aspiring journalists.
